states.headline: An episode failed its own verifier, was fixed, and passed it again

evidence.applicability: Applies to Python packages, libraries, or tools that users may launch through a module entry point.
evidence.lesson: When a package is intended to support module execution, provide and test its executable entry point; verify both direct imports and the package-as-module path so missing launch plumbing is caught before release.
